# All the run-form fields

Every field of the **Run** form, with its type, default and allowed values. Type, default and options come from the pipeline's `config/` folder; bounds come from the checks the steps run on the values. A field is a path with dashes: `train.batch_size` is `train-batch_size`. Fields set by a dropdown change when you pick another option, so their default is that of the option shown.

The run form also has a `<step>-class` field for each step: the machine it runs on, described in [Run on HPC (Slurm)](slurm.md).

> **Checked before training.** With `quantization-mode` = `ptq` or `qat`, the first step (`config-validation`) checks that `quantization-calibration_frames` is from 100 to 10000, so a wrong value fails in seconds.

## Run

| field | type | default | allowed | what it does |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `experiment-name` | text | `baseline` |  | The end of the MLflow experiment's name and the name of the folder the weights are saved in. The experiment is `<your app>.<this>` (just `<your app>` when empty). Letters, digits, `-` and `_` only. Reuse a name to compare runs. |
| `experiment-description` | text | empty |  | Free text stored on the MLflow run. |

## Dataset

| field | type | default | allowed | what it does |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `dataset` | text | `dataset-default@latest` |  | The data the run starts from: `<dataset>@<version>` (`dataset-spacecraft@v1`, `@latest`), or `<owner>/<dataset>@<version>` for a dataset shared with you. The default is your project's own default dataset, which holds no images at first: a run on it trains on a small sample that `prepare-data` makes (see `docs/datasets.md`). Choose a dataset of your own to train on your images. |

## Model

| field | type | default | allowed | what it does |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `model` | dropdown | `yolov8n` | options: `yolov11x`, `yolov8n`, `yolov8s` | Dropdown: which model size to train. |
| `model-variant` | text | `yolov8n-pose.pt` |  | The model file behind the dropdown (set by `model`). |
| `model-pretrained_weights` | text | empty |  | A `<repository>@<version>/<path>` reference to your own weights, for example `outputs-myapp@main/checkpoints/exp1/run1/best.pt` to start from (weights only, training starts at epoch 0). Empty uses the standard weights of the model. |

## Data loading

| field | type | default | allowed | what it does |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `data-sample_size` | int or empty | empty |  | Train on this many images, and their labels, per split (`train`, `val`, `test`), to make a quick test. `prepare-data` keeps them. Empty keeps every image. |
| `data-seed` | int | `42` |  | Picks which images `data-sample_size` keeps: the same seed keeps the same images. |

## Training

| field | type | default | allowed | what it does |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `train-epochs` | int | `10` | > 0 | Training rounds. 10 is enough for a first run on the small sample; use 100 or more on your own data. |
| `train-batch_size` | int | `16` | > 0 | Images per step, a positive number. |
| `train-image_size` | int | `320` | > 0, multiple of 32 | Input size in pixels, a multiple of 32. 320 suits the small sample; use 640 on your own images. |
| `train-cos_lr` | bool | `true` |  | Cosine learning-rate schedule. |
| `train-lrf` | float | `0.01` | > 0.0, <= 1.0 | Final learning rate as a fraction of the start. |
| `train-warmup_epochs` | float | `3.0` | >= 0.0 | Epochs of learning-rate warm-up. |
| `train-warmup_momentum` | float | `0.8` | >= 0.0, < 1.0 | Momentum during warm-up. |
| `train-dropout` | float | `0.0` | >= 0.0, < 1.0 | Dropout rate. |
| `train-label_smoothing` | float | `0.0` | >= 0.0, < 1.0 | Label smoothing. |
| `train-nbs` | int | `64` | > 0 | Nominal batch size used to scale gradients. |
| `train-freeze` | int or empty | empty | >= 0 | Freeze the first N backbone layers. Empty trains everything. |
| `train-amp` | bool | `true` |  | Automatic mixed precision. |
| `train-close_mosaic` | int | `3` | >= 0 | Switch the mosaic augmentation off for the last N epochs. |
| `train-seed` | int | `0` | >= 0 | Training random seed. |
| `train-deterministic` | bool | `true` |  | Deterministic GPU mode. |
| `train-loss-pose` | float | `12.0` | > 0.0 | Weight of the keypoint loss. |
| `train-loss-kobj` | float | `2.0` | > 0.0 | Weight of the keypoint-objectness loss. |
| `train-loss-box` | float | `7.5` | > 0.0 | Weight of the box loss. |
| `train-loss-cls` | float | `0.5` | > 0.0 | Weight of the class loss. |
| `train-loss-dfl` | float | `1.5` | > 0.0 | Weight of the distribution-focal loss. |
| `train-checkpointing-interval_epochs` | int | `10` | > 0 | Log a checkpoint to MLflow every N epochs. Resuming after a lost machine is automatic and does not depend on it. |
| `train-export-enabled` | bool | `false` |  | Also export the trained model (TensorRT or ONNX) after training. |
| `train-export-formats` | text | `engine` |  | Comma-separated: `engine`, `onnx`. |
| `train-export-precisions` | text | `fp16` |  | Comma-separated: `fp16`, `int8`. |
| `train-optimizer` | dropdown | `sgd` | options: `adam`, `adamw`, `sgd` | Dropdown: `sgd`, `adam`, `adamw`. |
| `train-optimizer-name` | text | `SGD` | one of SGD, Adam, AdamW, auto | Optimizer (set by the dropdown). |
| `train-optimizer-lr` | float | `0.01` | > 0.0 | Starting learning rate. |
| `train-optimizer-momentum` | float | `0.937` | >= 0.0, < 1.0 | Momentum (Adam: beta1). |
| `train-optimizer-weight_decay` | float | `0.0005` | >= 0.0 | Weight decay. |
| `train-callbacks` | dropdown | `early_stopping` | options: `early_stopping`, `none` | Dropdown: `early_stopping` or `none`. |
| `train-callbacks-early_stopping_enabled` | bool | `true` |  | Stop when the model stops improving (set by the dropdown). |
| `train-callbacks-patience` | int | `50` | >= 0 | Epochs without improvement before stopping. `0` never stops early. |
| `train-qat` | dropdown | `default_qat` | options: `default_qat`, `no_qat` | Dropdown: `default_qat` or `no_qat`. |
| `train-qat-epochs` | int | `10` | > 0 | Fine-tuning epochs of `qat` mode. |
| `train-qat-lr` | float | `0.0001` | > 0.0 | Learning rate of `qat` mode. |

## Augmentation

| field | type | default | allowed | what it does |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `image_processing` | dropdown | `mosaic_default` | options: `conservative`, `mosaic_default`, `none` | Dropdown: `mosaic_default`, `conservative` (light, for small datasets) or `none`. |
| `image_processing-hsv_h` | float | `0.015` | >= 0.0, <= 1.0 | Augmentation `hsv_h`. |
| `image_processing-hsv_s` | float | `0.7` | >= 0.0, <= 1.0 | Augmentation `hsv_s`. |
| `image_processing-hsv_v` | float | `0.4` | >= 0.0, <= 1.0 | Augmentation `hsv_v`. |
| `image_processing-degrees` | float | `0.0` | >= 0.0, <= 360.0 | Rotation augmentation in degrees. Keep 0 for pose: keypoints are rotation-sensitive. |
| `image_processing-translate` | float | `0.1` | >= 0.0 | Augmentation `translate`. |
| `image_processing-scale` | float | `0.5` | >= 0.0 | Augmentation `scale`. |
| `image_processing-shear` | float | `0.0` | >= 0.0 | Augmentation `shear`. |
| `image_processing-perspective` | float | `0.0` | >= 0.0, <= 0.001 | Perspective augmentation. Values above 0.001 displace keypoints badly. |
| `image_processing-flipud` | float | `0.0` | >= 0.0, <= 1.0 | Augmentation `flipud`. |
| `image_processing-fliplr` | float | `0.0` | >= 0.0, <= 1.0 | Probability of a left-right flip (needs `flip_idx` in `data.yaml`). |
| `image_processing-mosaic` | float | `1.0` | >= 0.0, <= 1.0 | Probability of the mosaic augmentation. |
| `image_processing-mixup` | float | `0.0` | >= 0.0, <= 1.0 | Augmentation `mixup`. |
| `image_processing-copy_paste` | float | `0.0` | >= 0.0, <= 1.0 | Augmentation `copy_paste`. |
| `image_processing-erasing` | float | `0.4` | >= 0.0, <= 0.9 | Augmentation `erasing`. |
| `image_processing-bgr` | float | `0.0` | >= 0.0, <= 1.0 | Augmentation `bgr`. |

## INT8 (quantization)

| field | type | default | allowed | what it does |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `quantization-mode` | text | `none` | one of none, ptq, qat | `none` (default) skips both INT8 steps; `ptq` quantizes the trained model; `qat` fine-tunes for INT8 first, then exports. |
| `quantization-image_size` | int | `320` | > 0 | Must equal `train-image_size`. |
| `quantization-calibration_frames` | int | `512` | >= 100, <= 10000 | Training images used to calibrate the INT8 model; 100 to 10000, checked before training when `quantization-mode` is `ptq` or `qat`. |
| `quantization-calibration_seed` | int | `42` |  | Seed for picking those images. |
| `quantization-parity_frames` | int | `100` | >= 1 | Images used to compare the INT8 and the full model. |
| `quantization-parity_max_abs_error` | float | `0.05` | > 0.0 | Largest allowed difference between the INT8 and the full model. Reported as the MLflow metric `parity_passed`; it does not fail the run. |

## Registration

| field | type | default | allowed | what it does |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `registration-registered_model_name` | text | `pose` |  | The end of the registered model's name: the model is `<your app>.<this>` (just `<your app>` when empty). Letters, digits, `-` and `_` only. |
| `registration-promote_to` | text | empty | empty, champion or challenger | The person starting the run sets this to give the registered version the alias `champion` or `challenger` when the run ends. Empty gives none. This is a model alias; moving a dataset's `latest` is the separate `promote-<dataset>` choice. |

| field | type | default | allowed | what it does |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `logging-level` | text | `INFO` |  | Log level of the steps. |
| `logging-log_artifacts` | bool | `true` |  | Upload plots and example images to MLflow. |
